hashStart: SINP International Skilled Worker Points Grid

extraWatch.what: SINP ISW EOI selection results PDF

appliesNote: International Skilled Worker: Saskatchewan Express Entry and Occupations In-Demand need at least 60 points; Employment Offer uses the same grid with 30 points for the job offer.

factors.label: Education and training
options: Bachelor's degree, or a degree of at least three years at a university or college
Trade certification equivalent to journeyperson status in Saskatchewan
Diploma requiring two (but less than three) years of post-secondary study
Certificate, or at least two semesters (less than a two-year program) of post-secondary study

factors.label: Skilled work experience in the 5 years before applying
Skilled work experience 6 to 10 years before applying

offer: High-skilled employment offer from a Saskatchewan employer (Employment Offer subcategory only)
relative: Close family relative in Saskatchewan who is a citizen or permanent resident
pastWork: At least 12 months of work in Saskatchewan in the past five years on a valid work permit
pastStudy: At least one full-time academic year at a recognized Saskatchewan post-secondary institution on a valid study permit
